132: [edit] These are days that tragedies happened to our ancestors and are therefore fitting for fasts. Even though some of them fall on Rosh Hodesh, there is a position that one should fast on them (though it is good to avoid completing a fast on Rosh Hodesh).

[edit] On the first of Nissan, the sons of Aaron died. On the tenth, Miriam died and the well disappeared. On the 26th, Joshua the son of Nun died. On the tenth of Iyyar, Eli the priest and his two sons died, and the Ark of God was captured. On the 28th, Samuel the prophet died. On the 23rd of Sivan, the bringing of first fruits to Jerusalem was canceled in the days of Jeroboam. On the 25th, Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, Rabbi Ishmael, and Rabbi Hanina the Deputy High Priest were killed. On the 27th Rabbi Hanina ben Teradion was burned with a Torah scroll. On the 18th, the western lamp was extinguished in the days of Ahaz. On the 17th of Elul, those who slandered the Land [of Israel] died. On the 5th of Tishrei, twenty men of Israel died and Rabbi Akiva was imprisoned. On the 7th, a decree was made that our ancestors would die by sword, famine, and plague as a result of the Golden Calf. On the 7th of Marheshvan Zedekiah was blinded and his sons were killed in front of him. On the 28th of Kislev, Jehoiakim burned the scroll that Baruch transcribed for Jeremiah. On the 8th of Tevet, the Torah was written in Greek in the age of King Ptolemy and there was darkness on the world for three days. On the 9th, we do not know what crisis occurred. On the 5th of Shevat, the elders in the era of Joshua died. On the 23rd, all of Israel ganged up on the tribe of Benjamin because of the concubine in Gibeah. On the 7th of Adar, Moses our teacher died, may peace be upon him. On the 9th, the houses of Hillel and Shamai split.

[edit] There is an opinion that there is a fast decreed for every Monday and Thursday because of the destruction of the Temple, the burning of the Torah, and the desecration of God's name. In the future, God will make these days of happiness and joy.
